explication: OpenClaw on Android is a standalone Android app that bootstraps its runtime, exposes setup and gateway controls through a WebView dashboard, and provides a built-in terminal. The principal workflow is: the user starts setup in the app, native bootstrap management prepares the environment, and the user continues in the terminal to onboard and run OpenClaw; the dashboard and settings provide runtime, tool, and maintenance controls. The graph includes the sampled native and terminal layers plus README-documented capabilities. Some UI-to-native dispatch details are unsampled, so those links are omitted or marked unverified.
